Ōtorohanga District Council

Ōtorohanga District covers 1976 square kilometres of beauty, from the peaceful seaside towns of Kāwhia and Aotea in the west, to tranquil Lake Arapuni on the eastern boundary. There are two urban centres of Ōtorohanga and Kāwhia, surrounded by thriving rural communities.

Our website is here to help our community engage with Council and help them complete tasks and service with Council easily.

Our King Country Future

Ōtorohanga and Waitomo District Councils are exploring a joint proposal under the Government’s new reform pathway. Find out more.

Latest News

RUBBISH & RECYCLING UPDATE – WE KNOW IT'S BEEN CONFUSING

With the change to our new kerbside rubbish and recycling contract, we know there's been a lot of information to take in, and understandably, plenty of questions.

Added 2 weeks ago

REG BRETT RESERVE & JIM BARKER PLAYGROUND TEMPORARY CLOSURE New

The Reg Brett Reserve and Jim Barker Playground (off Huiputea Dr) in Ōtorohanga will be temporarily closed for repairs from 13 July to the end of August 2026. The damage was caused by the February floods. The repair work and duration will be weather-dependent.

Added 5 days ago

GOOD DOGS GO GREEN THIS YEAR – REGISTER YOUR DOG NOW! New

Dog tags are green this year. If you haven’t already, this is a friendly reminder to register your dog for the 2026/27 year. Reminders were sent on 29 May, and registrations were due on 1 July. If you haven't done it yet, please do so as soon as possible to avoid late fees. If you’ve already completed the process but haven’t received your tag yet, rest assured – our customer experience team will be sending them out as soon as possible.

Added 7 days ago

APPLY FOR OUR COMMUNITY GRANTS!

Our Community Grants are open now and ready for your applications. All our funds provide community assistance to make our district a vibrant, supportive, and empowering place to live. This funding round closes on 31 July 2026 so be sure to get your applications in. You can check out all our grants at otodc.govt.nz/funding-and-grants.

Added 7 days ago

HAVE YOUR SAY – TWO SURVEYS, YOUR CHANCE TO SHAPE OUR DISTRICT

Your feedback helps us make better decisions and improve the services that matter most to our community.

Added 2 weeks ago

PROPOSAL TO CLOSE ROADS: HAMILTON CAR CLUB RALLY ANNUAL SPRINT 2026

In accordance with the Tenth Schedule of the Local Government Act 1974, notice is hereby given that the Ōtorohanga District Council, for the purpose of allowing the Hamilton Car Club Annual Rally Sprint 2026, proposes to close roads to ordinary vehicular traffic for the period indicated hereunder: Ōtorohanga District – Sunday 6th September 2026. For full details, including how to lodge a notice of objection (before Tuesday 14 July 2026), click to read the article.

Added 2 weeks ago

MAYOR URGES MOTORISTS TO MAKE THE RIGHT CHOICE THIS WINTER

Motorists across the Waikato are being reminded that Police can stop drivers for alcohol and roadside drug testing anywhere, at any time, as part of a region-wide effort to reduce deaths and serious injuries on our roads.

Added 2 weeks ago

RISING LEADER: NATIONAL RECOGNITION FOR CASSIDY TEMESE

Our Council Kaitakawaenga - Iwi Relations Advisor, Cassidy Temese, was honoured for their outstanding contribution to our communities at the LGFA Taituarā Local Government Excellence Awards. Taituarā is Aotearoa New Zealand's leading membership network for professionals working in and for local government.

Added 2 weeks ago

RUBBISH BAG UPDATE AND TEMPORARY CLOSURES (ŌTOROHANGA WASTE TRANSFER STATION & RURAL RECYCLING SITES)

From 1 July, Evolve Ventures Limited will begin delivering Council's new kerbside rubbish collection service. If you do not receive a new blue recycling crate by close of business Tuesday 30 June, please contact Council.

Added 3 weeks ago
